title: Returning Result from Main
goal: Allow main to propagate errors directly with the try operator by returning a Result.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Error Handling

hints: To use the try operator, the function return type must be a compatible Result.
Box<dyn Error> accepts any standard error type returned by the try operator.
explanation: Returning `Result<(), Box<dyn Error>>` allows using the `?` operator to propagate errors cleanly. Using `()` prevents using `?` (`E0277`). Using `.unwrap()` panics on invalid input instead of returning an `Err` result.
